title: A Orchard for the Tide
author: Xanthe Okafor
blurb: Sebastian Galloway, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
